title: Ethical-Advice Taker: Do Language Models Understand Natural Language Interventions?
benchmark_measurement: Measuring a model's ability to adjust its stereotypical biases related to religion when given natural language ethical interventions.
findings: Models like RoBERTa fail to understand ethical interventions about religious stereotypes in a zero-shot setting. With few-shot fine-tuning on the religion domain, they can learn to follow the interventions, but this learning does not generalize well to other bias domains like gender or ethnicity.
